description: Every country this service knows, one row each, flagged for whether IBAN validation and bank lookup are available. The two differ: more countries have a known IBAN format than have a bank register behind them, and the summary line gives both totals. Call it once up front to find out whether a country can be answered at all; use get_country_iban_format for one country's rules, and analyze_iban when an IBAN is already in hand. The answer changes rarely and is worth keeping for the rest of the session rather than re-fetching. Requires an X-Api-Key header but costs no allowance.
name: list_supported_countries
title: Countries covered
